title: Topic 14: Work & Study - Vocabulary
description: Core words for work & study: job, teacher, doctor, student, office, speak, write, help (teacher and student promoted from sight words - used since Topic 1 - to active, tested vocabulary). 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
canDoStatement: Talk about your job or studies
introductionText:
job = your work: teacher, doctor...
teacher = teaches students (your English teacher!)
doctor = works at the hospital
student = studies at school
office = the work room with tables, chairs, computers
speak = talk (speak English!)  |  write = make words
on paper  |  help = do good things for a person
+ phrase bank: What is your job? | I am a... |
I can speak English!
+ grammar note: I am A teacher / AN office worker
(a/an + job). can + verb: NO -s, ever!

grammarBlocks.title: CAN + verb = ABILITY (G11 second half: I can speak English -
grammarBlocks.explanation: CAN + verb = ABILITY (G11 second half: I can speak English - can never takes -s) + A/AN with jobs (I am A teacher) + 3rd person -s consolidation (G7)
patterns: a/an + job: a doctor, a teacher, an office
can + base verb, ALL persons the same:
I can speak / she can speak (never cans,
